Bakirci’s campaign was endorsed by the largest Turkish Cypriot political party, the UBP, and had initially been elected to the role in 2022 […]

ai.sum: Hamit Bakirci was re-elected unopposed as mayor of Turkish Cypriot Yialousa and Rizokarpaso, backed by the UBP.

items.title: Zelensky expresses condolences to Türkiye following tragedy at steel plant
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed his condolences to Türkiye following a tragedy at a steel plant that claimed several lives and left others injured.

ai.sum: Zelensky sent condolences to Türkiye after a steel plant tragedy that killed several people.

items.title: ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Rubio: İsrail bizden silah alabilir ama artık finansman sağlamamız gerekmiyor
items.summary: ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, İsrail'in finansal açıdan yeterli bir seviyede olduğunu ve ülkesinin artık Tel Aviv yönetimine finansman sağlamasına gerek kalmadığını ifade etti.

ai.sum: Rubio said Israel can still buy US weapons but the US no longer needs to finance Israel because its finances are sufficient.
ai.title_en: Rubio: Israel can buy weapons from us but we no longer need to provide financing

items.title: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
items.summary: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.

ai.sum: The UN COP31 climate summit opened in Antalya as the Iran war disrupts global energy supplies.

items.title: Türkiye finds 2 new Gabar oil fields, eyes 100,000 barrels daily by 2027: Erdogan

ai.sum: Erdoğan said Türkiye found two new Gabar oil fields and aims for 100,000 barrels per day by 2027.
